params._comment: W7 expansion SKYWARD beat, CUT-EXPANSION reshoot: player-anchored LAUNCH instead of a standing tilt. Anticipation dip (t.12), vertical rush with the FOV kicking 70->85 (speed), cloud-layer punch-through at t.40 (translucent veil fade here + a cutscene_veil wisp burst scheduled by ExpansionSequence at the same fraction), world-curvature reveal at the apex looking DOWN over the disc (t.62, whisper caption), then the tilt up into the darkening sky for the eclipse-grade hold. Bezier so the rush settles at the apex and the sky hold instead of overshooting. The follow-up shot is expansion_flyover.
params._doc: Per-keyframe 'fov' (degrees, default 70) is smoothly lerped along the flight by CameraDirector.onComputeFov and eases back into the player's own FOV at the end. Top-level 'showOwnBody' (default false) keeps the watcher's own player model visible — author true only for shots that deliberately frame the watcher.
